description: Report something stopping the signed-in worker on a run they are committed to or working now, as the report-issue button on their my-work page does; planners see it in list_labor_issues. reason is materials, equipment, quality, instructions or other; note describes it (1–1000 characters). Name the run by operationId, or by workOrder and operationCode. One open issue per worker per run. In-app only (User role; the account must be linked to a worker). Preview first; the in-app assistant gets a confirm card.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

operationCode.description: The run's operation code, with workOrder.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

reason.description: materials, equipment, quality, instructions or other.

workOrder.description: The run's work order number, with operationCode.

name: report_labor_issue
title: Report Labor Issue
